title: Stock market technicals, cycles, sentiment and money flow point to lower prices.
speaker: Chris Vermeulen (TheTechnicalTraders)

macro_themes.view: AI overspending fears are back; if tech/semis top out, could spark a big bear market.
System says unfavourable; when the stock market falls everything falls, so hold no stocks.
Fed is in a pickle with high inflation; yields likely resume higher after a short-term top.

calls.reason: S&P in short-term downtrend, money flowing out, momentum stalled; system says do not hold stocks.
calls.quote: the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq both are in a short-term downtrend. Our system says it's unfavorable. You should not be holding any stocks.

calls.reason: Tech and semis breaking below recent lows; a topping formation could unwind quickly into a bear market.
calls.quote: If this here is a top and it starts to break down, things could unwind very quickly to the next level

calls.reason: Short-term top in yields, pulling back to 50-day, then likely to strengthen higher unless a fast bear market forces Fed cuts.
calls.quote: This, I think, will strengthen and probably continue to go higher

calls.reason: Money flowing into oil; spiked to 110, within striking distance of 115-120 upside targets.
calls.quote: Oil spiked all the way up to 110. Moving up to our next upside targets, which is like the 115 and 120 area.

calls.reason: VIX still elevated; may see another bout of AI selling and a VIX spike.
calls.quote: we might actually still see another bout of selling here with the AI space and we might see a spike in the VIX

notes: Oil 110 is the spike high mentioned, not necessarily current price. Speaker name not said in transcript; channel host assumed.
